```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(dplyr)

```

We will run this simulation for two settings in case of Linear model with Gaussian noise, with engenity induced using (a) unobserved confounders, and (b) correlated error.

```{r}
# Settings for generating data
family = c("Gaussian", "NB")[1]
endog_mode = c("confounder", "correlated_error")[1]
snr_X = c(1, 3, 5)[3]
snr_Y = c(1, 3, 5)[3]
tem = c(0.2, 0.5, 0.8)[2]
if (endog_mode == "confounder") {tem <- 0.7; snr_X <- 8}
case <- paste0(family, "_", endog_mode)
k = 3    # number of latent dimensions  # Variable assignment or computation step
n = 200  # number of samples  # Variable assignment or computation step
d = 100  # number of microbes  # Variable assignment or computation step
m = 40   # number of instruments  # Variable assignment or computation step
c = 3    # number of observed confounders  # Variable assignment or computation step
diagonal_elements = c(3, 4, 5)


# Run simulation
sim_data_gauss <- simulate_iv_data( n = 200, d = 100, m = 40, c = 3, k = 3,
    diagonal_elements = c(3, 4, 5),
    family = family,
    endog_mode = endog_mode,
    snr_X = snr_X,
    snr_Y = snr_Y,
    tem = tem, disp = 2,
    seed = 123)

attach(sim_data_gauss)
  
```

```{r}
# ---- Purpose: Setup / dependencies / options | Simulation parameter initialization | Model fitting (LM/GLM) | Instrumental-variable / GMM estimation | Visualization with ggplot2 / heatmaps | Data wrangling (dplyr) | Save outputs to disk ----
# Notes: Annotated for readability; core logic unchanged.
library(gofar)    # Load package
family <- list(gaussian(), binomial(), poisson())
control <- gofar_control()
nlam <- 50 # number of tuning parameter
SD <- 123

# Model fitting begins:
control$epsilon <- 1e-7
control$spU <- 1.1
control$spV <- 1.1
control$maxit <- 1000
control$gamma0 <- 1
control$equalphi <- 1
control$lamMaxFac <- 1
control$lamMinFac <- 1e-10
familygroup <- rep(1,d)
control$se1 <- 1


# Model fitting: GOFAR(S) (full data)
set.seed(SD)    # Fix RNG seed for reproducibility
rank.est <- 5
# fit.seqT <- gofar_p(scale(X, center = F, scale = F),
#                     scale(cbind(Q,Z), center = F, scale = F), cIndex = 1:c,
#                    nrank = rank.est, family = family,
#                    nlambda = nlam, familygroup = familygroup,
#                    control = control, nfold = 5
# )
# 
# save(fit.seqT, file = sprintf("output/%s_spreduced.rds", case))
load(sprintf("output/%s_spreduced.rds", case))

# Investigate solution path of each of the unit-rank components
plot(colMeans(fit.seqT$cv_details[[1]]$dev))
plot(colMeans(fit.seqT$cv_details[[2]]$dev))
plot(colMeans(fit.seqT$cv_details[[3]]$dev))
plot(colMeans(fit.seqT$cv_details[[4]]$dev))
# ---------------------------------------------------------

# Extract latent factor for the second stage of IV analysis
perf <- rep(0,3)
ZU <- Z %*% fit.seqT$U %*% diag(fit.seqT$D)
fit.ls1 <- fit.ls <- lm(Y ~ ZU+Q)    # Fit model
alpha_iv <- fit.seqT$V %*% coef(fit.ls1)[2:(ncol(fit.seqT$V)+1)]
plot(Y,predict(fit.ls))
abline(a = 0, b = 1, col=2)
perf[1] <- summary(lm(Y~predict(fit.ls)))$r.squared    # Fit model

library (ggplot2)    # Begin plot
pldf <- data.frame(Yh = predict(fit.ls));pldf$Y <- Y[,1]
signif(summary(fit.ls)$adj.r.squared, 2)
pl_1 <- ggplot(pldf, aes(x = Y, y = Yh)) +     # Begin plot
  geom_point() + xlab('y') + ylab(expression(hat(y))) +     # Plot layers / styling
  stat_smooth(method = "lm", col = "red") +
  annotate("label",x = Inf, y = Inf, vjust = 1,
           hjust = 1,
           label = sprintf("R^2 == %f",signif(perf[1],2)),  
           parse = TRUE) +    
  theme_bw() +
  theme( panel.spacing=unit(0.2,"lines"),    # Plot layers / styling
         strip.background = element_blank(),
         legend.position = 'top',
         plot.title = element_text(size = 15, hjust = 0.5, color = 'black'),
         axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, color = 'black',angle = 90,vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1.0),
         axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, color = 'black',angle = 0),
         axis.title = element_text(size = 15, color = 'black'),
         strip.text = element_text(size = 13, color = 'black', angle = 0),
         legend.text = element_text(size = 10, color = 'black', angle = 0),
         legend.background = element_rect(fill="grey95",
                                          size=0.5, linetype="solid"),
         legend.title =  element_text(size = 13, color = 'black', face = 'bold',
                                      angle = 0, hjust = 0.5) )
  
pl_1

perf[2] <- summary(lm(as.vector(beta) ~ as.vector(beta_est) ))$r.squared    # Fit model
```

```{r}
alpha_naiv <- estimate_alpha_naive(X, Y, Q, p_adj_method = "BH", alpha_level = 0.05)
alpha_naive <- alpha_naiv$alpha_hat_shrunk
# alpha_true <- t(betaV) %*% alpha
alpha_true <- alpha

# Mean Squared Error
mse_iv    <- mean((alpha_iv - alpha_true)^2)
mse_naive <- mean((alpha_naive - alpha_true)^2)
  
# Compute R²
r2_iv    <- cor(alpha_true, alpha_iv)^2
r2_naive <- cor(alpha_true, alpha_naive)^2
  
cat("---- Performance Summary ----\n")
cat(sprintf("IV model:     MSE = %.4f | R² = %.3f\n", mse_iv, r2_iv))
cat(sprintf("Naïve model:  MSE = %.4f | R² = %.3f\n", mse_naive, r2_naive))
  
# Combine into tidy data frame for ggplot
df_long <- data.frame(
    TrueAlpha = alpha_true,
    IV        = alpha_iv,
    Naive     = alpha_naive) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(IV, Naive),
                 names_to = "Method",
                 values_to = "Estimate")
  
# Create a label table for each facet
method_labels <- data.frame(
    Method = c("IV", "Naive"),
    R2 = c(r2_iv, r2_naive),
    MSE = c(mse_iv, mse_naive)
)
df_long <- df_long %>%
    left_join(method_labels, by = "Method") %>%
    mutate(Method = factor(Method, levels = c("IV", "Naive"),
                           labels = c("Factor IV", "Naive OLS")))
  
# # Faceted plot
# p_faceted <- ggplot(df_long, aes(x = TrueAlpha, y = Estimate)) +

#     )
#   ) +
#   scale_color_manual(values = c("Factor IV" = "#0072B2", "Naïve OLS" = "#D55E00")) +
#   theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
#   theme(
#     legend.position = "none",
#     strip.background = element_rect(fill = "lightgrey", color = "black"),
#     strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
#     plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14)
#   )



p_combined <- ggplot(df_long, aes(x = TrueAlpha, y = Estimate)) +
  # points colored by Method
  geom_point(aes(color = Method), size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  # separate regression lines per Method (same color mapping)
  geom_smooth(aes(color = Method),
              method = "lm", se = FALSE, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    x = expression("True " * alpha),
    y = expression("Estimated " * alpha),
    title = expression("Comparison of True vs Estimated " * alpha),
    subtitle = paste0(
      sprintf("Factor IV: R^2 = %.3f, MSE = %.3f", r2_iv, mse_iv),
      "\n",
      sprintf("Naive OLS: R^2 = %.3f, MSE = %.3f", r2_naive, mse_naive)
    )
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Factor IV" = "#0072B2",
      "Naive OLS" = "#D55E00"   # make sure this matches df_long$Method exactly
    )
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 15) +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14)
  )
```

We will run this simulation for two settings in case of negative binomial model, with endogenity induced using (a) unobserved confounders, and (b) correlated error.


```{r}
# Settings for generating data
family = c("Gaussian", "NB")[2]
endog_mode = c("confounder", "correlated_error")[2]
snr_X = c(1, 3, 5)[3]
snr_Y = c(1, 3, 5)[3]
tem = c(0.2, 0.5, 0.8)[2]
if (endog_mode == "confounder") {tem <- 0.7; snr_X <- 8}
case <- paste0(family, "_", endog_mode)
k = 3    # number of latent dimensions  # Variable assignment or computation step
n = 200  # number of samples  # Variable assignment or computation step
d = 100  # number of microbes  # Variable assignment or computation step
m = 40   # number of instruments  # Variable assignment or computation step
c = 2    # number of observed confounders  # Variable assignment or computation step
diagonal_elements = c(3, 4, 5)


# Run simulation
sim_data_gauss <- simulate_iv_data( n = 200, d = 100, m = 40, c = c, k = k,
    diagonal_elements = c(1, 2, 3),
    family = family,
    endog_mode = endog_mode,
    snr_X = snr_X,
    snr_Y = snr_Y,
    tem = tem, disp = 5,
    seed = 123)

attach(sim_data_gauss)
```

```{r}
alpha_naiv_deseq <- estimate_alpha_naive_deseq2(X = X, Q = Q, 
                                                y = Y, alpha_level = 0.05)

alpha_naive <- alpha_naiv_deseq$alpha_naive
alpha_true <- alpha
alpha_iv <- alpha_iv_nb
# Mean Squared Error
mse_iv    <- mean((alpha_iv - alpha_true)^2)
mse_naive <- mean((alpha_naive - alpha_true)^2)
  
# Compute R²
r2_iv    <- cor(alpha_true, alpha_iv)^2
r2_naive <- cor(alpha_true, alpha_naive)^2
  
cat("---- Performance Summary ----\n")
cat(sprintf("IV model:     MSE = %.4f | R² = %.3f\n", mse_iv, r2_iv))
cat(sprintf("Naïve model:  MSE = %.4f | R² = %.3f\n", mse_naive, r2_naive))
  
# Combine into tidy data frame for ggplot
df_long <- data.frame(
    TrueAlpha = alpha_true,
    IV        = alpha_iv,
    Naive     = alpha_naive) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(IV, Naive),
                 names_to = "Method",
                 values_to = "Estimate")
  
# Create a label table for each facet
method_labels <- data.frame(
    Method = c("IV", "Naive"),
    R2 = c(r2_iv, r2_naive),
    MSE = c(mse_iv, mse_naive)
)
df_long <- df_long %>%
    left_join(method_labels, by = "Method") %>%
    mutate(Method = factor(Method, levels = c("IV", "Naive"),
                           labels = c("Factor IV", "Naive OLS")))
  
# # Faceted plot
# p_faceted <- ggplot(df_long, aes(x = TrueAlpha, y = Estimate)) +
#   geom_point(aes(color = Method), size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
#   geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
#   facet_wrap(~ Method, scales = "free") +
#   labs(
#     x = expression("True " * alpha),
#     y = expression("Estimated " * alpha),
#     title = expression("Comparison of True vs Estimated " * alpha),
#     subtitle = paste0(
#       sprintf("Factor IV: R² = %.3f, MSE = %.4f | ", r2_iv, mse_iv),
#       sprintf("DESEQ2: R² = %.3f, MSE = %.4f", r2_naive, mse_naive)
#     )
#   ) +
#   scale_color_manual(values = c("Factor IV" = "#0072B2", "Naïve OLS" = "#D55E00")) +
#   theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
#   theme(
#     legend.position = "none",
#     strip.background = element_rect(fill = "lightgrey", color = "black"),
#     strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
#     plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14)
#   )
# 
#   
# # Print or save
# print(p_faceted)


p_combined <- ggplot(df_long, aes(x = TrueAlpha, y = Estimate)) +
  # points colored by Method
  geom_point(aes(color = Method), size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  # separate regression lines per Method (same color mapping)
  geom_smooth(aes(color = Method),
              method = "lm", se = FALSE, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    x = expression("True " * alpha),
    y = expression("Estimated " * alpha),
    title = expression("Comparison of True vs Estimated " * alpha),
    subtitle = paste0(
      sprintf("Factor IV: R^2 = %.3f, MSE = %.3f", r2_iv, mse_iv),
      "\n",
      sprintf("DESEQ2: R^2 = %.3f, MSE = %.3f", r2_naive, mse_naive)
    )
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Factor IV" = "#0072B2",
      "DESEQ2" = "#D55E00"   # make sure this matches df_long$Method exactly
    )
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 15) +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14)
  )
  
# Print or save
print(p_combined)


ggsave(filename = sprintf("plots/%s_alpha_comparison_deseq2.pdf", case),
      plot = p_combined, width = 5, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```
